text:
sara: Heads up — after OFED 5.9.1 + EFA firmware 1.4.3 rolled in eu-west2 this morning, we’re seeing NCCL allreduce latency jumps and variable bandwidth across batches. Some jobs fall back to TCP intermittently.

mike: saw the alerts. graphs?

sara: attaching quick summary: 50% of p99 token latency doubled on 4xA100 jobs. bandwidth trimmed from ~140GB/s down to 40-80GB/s in waves. No full node OOMs.

alex: any kernel module errors in dmesg?

sara: yes, repeating EFA driver log lines, e.g.:
```
[ 1234.567890] efa: failing to register qp: -22
[ 1234.568012] mlx5_core 0000:02:00.0: irq 29 for MSI/MSI-X
[ 1235.001234] nv_peer_memory: mmap failed - return -12
```

josh: NV driver version on those hosts?

sara: mixed. we upgraded kernel to 6.2.14 and rolled NVIDIA 535.86 on the same wave, but some nodes still on 535.54 from canary. Could be ABI mismatch.

mike: that would explain nv_peer_memory errors — if the kernel+nv combo changed CQ/doorbell behavior EFA may requeue and NCCL falls back.

linda: are we seeing this only on eu-west2 or other regions?

sara: eu-west2 primarily (first rollout), small hits in euc1 test pool where we staged images. us-west unaffected so far.

infra-bot: Deploy job #2234 rolled OFED 5.9.1 to eu-west2 at 2087654000 UTC.

alex: quick checks: MTU mismatch? cpumasks? irqbalance pinned?

sara: MTU consistent at 9000. BUT noticed cpuset changes during deploy — kubelet set cpu-manager: guaranteed pods got isolated cpus causing different irq/affinity. suspect IRQs moved off CPU cores that were pinned for nv_peer.

josh: can we repro by forcing the nv driver to older known good on a single node?

mike: let's try 535.54 + rollback OFED on a single failed node. Also grab perf counters: ib_read_bw + ib_write_bw + nvidia-smi pmon + ethtool -S mlx5_core.

sara: I spun up a repro job on node euw2-kube-12 with nv 535.54 and OFED 5.8.7 — initial run shows stable bandwidth ~138GB/s and NCCL no fallback.

linda: good. can we snapshot the full node (ami/snapshot) and roll rest back if confirmed? cost-ops: rollback will cost ~3h disruption for batches, estimate 12k/hr lost if we pause queued jobs — ok to request?

mike: thumbs up on rollback for the rest of the pool. Also open a ticket with Mellanox/driver team — provide dmesg, firmware, and exact kernel/NV versions.

alex: small mitigation: enable NCCL_TOPO_FILE to avoid fallback across mixed transport? (won't fix driver bug but reduces variance).

sara: action list: 1) isolate and rollback eu-west2 to OFED 5.8.7 + NV 535.54 on canary nodes (josh+mike) 2) gather ethtool/dmesg/perf for vendor (sara+alex) 3) pause new batch scheduling on affected pool (linda) 4) postmortem if confirmed.

josh: starting canary rollback now on three nodes. ping when done.

infra-bot: Canary rollback job #2235 started at 2087654500 UTC.

mike: also add cpuidle/irqbalance note to ticket — we saw IRQ affinity flip during deploy, could contribute.

sara: thanks all — will update thread with perf graphs and vendor ticket id. :thumbsup:
